definitions.explanation: A shimmering illusion of water on a hot road or field that recedes as you approach it, caused by heated air bending light near the surface.

examples.english: A road mirage appeared on the summer road.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逃|に}げ{水|みず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}っている→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
examples.english: A mirage is shimmering on the distant road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近|ちか}づいて→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{逃|に}げ{水|みず}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どんどん→どんどん：01261_dondon⟧⟦{遠|とお}ざかって→遠ざかる：14379_toozakaru⟧いく。
examples.english: Even as you approach, the road mirage keeps receding into the distance.

notes:
An optical illusion in which hot air just above a road surface bends light, so a patch of 'water' seems to lie ahead and flee (⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧) as one approaches. A common summer sight on paved roads.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逃|に}げ{水|みず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: a road mirage appears
- {逃|に}げ{水|みず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧: to chase a mirage (also figurative: to pursue something unattainable)
